## vCluster - Senior Software Engineer – Product Security

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/vclusterlabs/3dc34e16-8854-4a09-b829-f8c97328e636)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Product Security Engineer building secure Go and Kubernetes features for vCluster Labs’ AI infrastructure platform. Owning vulnerability response, threat modeling, and secure design reviews.
Senior Product Security Engineer securing vCluster Labs’ Kubernetes AI infrastructure platform
- Salary: $135,000 - $175,000 per year
- Tech stack: Kubernetes, Go
- Design, build, and maintain production features alongside the engineering team
- Work on roadmap features when security work is not in the queue
- Triage, prioritize, and fix security issues in code and dependencies through a patched release
- Review security-sensitive designs and threat-model new features
- Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions
- Help engineers build secure defaults into the product
- Serve as the security expert for the product
- Build secure infrastructure software for AI infrastructure platforms and Kubernetes-based tenant isolation
- Experience building and shipping production systems with Go as a primary language
- Working knowledge of Kubernetes API server, admission control, RBAC, controllers, and kubelet
- Experience building controllers or operators with controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or client-go
- Hands-on experience with container breakout, privilege escalation, RBAC, and policy best practices
- Experience threat modeling and reviewing designs for production systems
- Ability to explain risk clearly to other engineers
- Experience investigating and fixing vulnerabilities in code
- Knowledge of the CVE lifecycle, coordinated disclosure, and patch releases

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Product Security Engineer building secure Go and Kubernetes features for vCluster Labs’ AI infrastructure platform. Owning vulnerability response, threat modeling, and secure design reviews.
Senior Product Security Engineer securing vCluster Labs’ Kubernetes AI infrastructure platform
Role description:
• Design, build, and maintain production features alongside the engineering team
• Work on roadmap features when security work is not in the queue
• Triage, prioritize, and fix security issues in code and dependencies through a patched release
• Review security-sensitive designs and threat-model new features
• Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions
• Help engineers build secure defaults into the product
• Serve as the security expert for the product
• Build secure infrastructure software for AI infrastructure platforms and Kubernetes-based tenant isolation
Role requirements:
• Experience building and shipping production systems with Go as a primary language
• Working knowledge of Kubernetes API server, admission control, RBAC, controllers, and kubelet
• Experience building controllers or operators with controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or client-go
• Hands-on experience with container breakout, privilege escalation, RBAC, and policy best practices
• Experience threat modeling and reviewing designs for production systems
• Ability to explain risk clearly to other engineers
• Experience investigating and fixing vulnerabilities in code
• Knowledge of the CVE lifecycle, coordinated disclosure, and patch releases
• CKS certification is a bonus
• Experience at an early-stage organization is a bonus
Benefits:
• Competitive compensation package including equity
• Health, dental, vision, and life insurance for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country)
• Flexible working schedule
• Workplace flexibility
• Equity
• Bonus
Tech stack:
Kubernetes, Go
